watch.name: order-problem-by-number
watch.nl_query: Tell me if there's a problem or a delay with order XR-4471.

nodes.comment: The order number is the whole point: an embedding cannot retrieve it, so the lexical arm nominates and the judge decides whether what it nominated is a problem.

judge.proposition: This email reports a problem, delay or change to order XR-4471 rather than merely confirming it
